messages:
kevin: Mid-standup: my whole screen froze during a demo, Zoom spinner of doom. restarted, but webcam now has a weird green tint and my dog is giving me side-eye. pic: https://files.redwood.com/kevin/window_sill_setup.jpg
rachel: green tint sounds like a bad color profile or camera driver. try unplugging/replugging and check camera settings in Zoom
kevin: unplugged, replugged. camera shows green in other apps too. here's a quick lsusb / system info:
```
Bus 002 Device 004: ID 046d:0825 Logitech, Inc. Webcam C270
Driver: uvcvideo
```
mina: might be UVC driver bug. on linux try: `v4l2-ctl --list-formats-ext -d /dev/video0` and force a supported format/frame rate
leo: also check the USB cable and port — some cheap hubs cause power issues and weird colors
infra-bot: Heads-up: home-network maintenance scheduled 2026-04-10 22:00 UTC. If you're using on-site ISP gateways, expect brief drops. (reaction: :warning:)
rachel: if camera still busted, quick workaround: use phone as camera via USB or wifi (apps like DroidCam or EpocCam). works well for demos
kevin: used my phone as a cam, better image. also cleaned up the windowsill chaos. added a small LED lamp and moved the cactus before it could judge me. pic: https://files.redwood.com/kevin/window_sill_after.jpg :partyparrot:
mina: excellent recovery. also pro tip: tape a small piece of diffusion (like tissue) over LED for softer light
leo: 10/10 dog side-eye preserved. will send my cable tie recommendations later :thumbsup:
kevin: thanks team. demo back on and the dog is now an enthusiastic co-presenter :dog:
